scope: All exp4 saved clinical model comparisons: 184 earlier learned configurations plus four repeated-CV TypeNet classifier families. Dummy controls and CV-selected-family procedure are separate.
ranking: Classification: real-participant test accuracy descending, AUROC breaks ties. Regression: test MAE ascending. All original, expanded, distribution and TypeNet results included; unrelated endpoints are not pooled.
limitations: Retrospective test-score ranking, not a new validation exercise.
TypeNet numbers average 25 CV-selected fold models; preceding runs are single fitted configurations.
Clinical motor PD uses the same 17 test participants across runs, but representations and aggregation differ.
Combined-row rankings are separated by synthetic dataset; their test sets differ.
Earlier experiments outside exp4 are not included.
